question: Estimate the cost of operating a Tier 2 city Indian mall.
idealClarificationQuestions: Mid-sized mall (~5 lakh sqft) in Tier 2 city (Indore / Coimbatore / Lucknow)? Yes.
Annual operating cost (excludes financing costs)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Tier 2 mall annual operating cost stack:

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Operating margin (after CAM is recovered from tenants): ~₹40-50 Cr operating profit.

calculationFlow: - Common Area Maintenance (CAM) — utilities, housekeeping, security, AC: ~₹20-25 Cr/year (~5L sqft × ₹40-50/sqft/month × 12).
Plus revenue share, parking, ad income: ~₹15 Cr.
Operating margin (after CAM is recovered from tenants): ~₹40-50 Cr operating profit.
